items.title: NDSU Travels to San Jose State for Friday Afternoon Non-Conference Game
items.summary: THIS WEEK: The North Dakota State football team closes out the regular season this week when the Bison (9-2, 6-2 MW) take on the San Jose State Spartans (5-7, 3-5 MW) in a non-conference game set for 12:30 p.m. PST (2:30 p.m. CST) on Friday, Nov. 27, at CEFCU Stadium (19,000) in San Jose, Calif.

items.title: Hayes Earns Third MW Offensive Player of the Week Award
items.summary: LAS VEGAS - North Dakota State quarterback Nathan Hayes was named Old Trapper Mountain West Offensive Player of the Week on Monday, Nov. 23, for his performance against Northern Illinois. It is his third award of the season.

items.title: NDSU Finishes 6-2 in Mountain West With Harvest Bowl Win Over NIU
items.summary: FARGO, N.D. - Nathan Hayes passed for a career-high 247 yards and four touchdowns to lead North Dakota State to a 31-25 victory over Northern Illinois on Saturday, Nov. 21, before a crowd of 18,111 in the annual Harvest Bowl game at Gate City Bank Field at the Fargodome.

items.title: NDSU Closes Out Mountain West Schedule Saturday With NIU in Harvest Bowl
items.summary: THIS WEEK: North Dakota State closes out its first season of Mountain West Conference play against another first-year league member Saturday, Nov. 21, when the Bison (8-2, 5-2 MW) host the Northern Illinois Huskies (0-10, 0-6 MW) in the final regular-season home game of the season. items.title: James Named MW Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: LAS VEGAS - North Dakota State's Ray James Jr. was named Old Trapper Mountain West Defensive Player of the Week by the conference office Monday, Nov. 16. It is the first player of the week award of his career.

items.title: Bison Rally Past Hawaii in Fourth Quarter, 21-13
items.summary: HONOLULU, Hawaii - North Dakota State scored two touchdowns in the fourth quarter, including a 49-yard interception return by Ray James Jr., and earned a 21-13 victory over Hawaii on Saturday, Nov. 14, at a rainy Clarence T.C. Ching Athletics Complex.

items.title: NDSU Partners with Applied Digital for Football Helmet Bumper, Scheels Center Court Signage
items.summary: FARGO, N.D. — North Dakota State Athletics and Learfield's Bison Sports Properties today announced Applied Digital as the official helmet bumper partner of Bison football. NDSU is one of the first programs in the country to announce a helmet bumper sponsorship in college football.

items.title: Bison Travel to Hawaii for Saturday Night Matchup on The CW
items.summary: THIS WEEK: The North Dakota State football team makes its first visit to Hawaii this week when the Bison (7-2, 4-2 MW) take on the Hawaii Rainbow Warriors (3-6, 2-4 MW). Game time is 6:10 p.m. HST (10:10 p.m. CST) on Saturday, Nov. 14, at the Clarence T.C. Ching Complex (15,014) in Honolulu.

items.title: Moore Named MW Freshman of the Week
items.summary: LAS VEGAS - North Dakota State cornerback Marion Moore was named Old Trapper Mountain West Freshman of the Week on Monday, Nov. 2, by the conference office. It is Moore's second award of the season.

items.title: North Dakota State Defeats UTEP, 31-7
items.summary: FARGO, N.D. - Nathan Hayes passed for 240 yards and North Dakota State forced three turnovers en route to a 31-7 victory over UTEP in Mountain West football Saturday, Oct. 31, before a crowd of 15,513 at Gate City Bank Field at the Fargodome.
